technicalChecks.result: All nine selected source PNGs are non-empty RGBA files with transparent pixels. The shared preparer centered approved artwork without upscaling; all six rendered 1080x1440 XHS cards and responsive course screenshots were inspected separately in runs/day77/verification/.

accepted.review: Bojji's controlled low-step preparation and Despa's open planning gesture communicate functional progression and risk discussion without a scale, stadium, medical prop or text.
The stable bench sit and close-to-body carrying setup give a clear functional-training cue without body comparison, weighing or an unsafe lift.
The revised scene uses a solid four-legged low wooden platform and a structurally complete bench; both characters have stable, non-extreme positions with no pain or fall cue.
A close carrying task, chest-held medicine ball and unmarked rigid planning board distinguish daily and sport-task needs without a competition, medal, label or arrow.

The dumbbell is horizontally placed at the lower image edge without a floor or projection; Bojji's water cup and pause gesture support reduced training risk without depicting a diagnosis, body stereotype or medical symbol.
The dedicated 4:3 sit-and-carry overview is compositionally distinct from the wide knowledge illustration and retains a stable bench plus wordless functional cue.
The separate overview uses a stable low platform and complete bench support with no skeletal diagram, pain symbol, floor or fall image.
The independent planning-board, carrying and medicine-ball scene visually expresses task comparison while staying wordless and free of stadium, medal or arrow cues.
The overview-only pause scene keeps the dumbbell flat at the lower edge without a rendered ground, pairs it with a water cup and closed blank folder, and avoids diagnostic or gender stereotypes.

rejected.reason: The requested stable low training step was rendered as a cardboard box, which is an unsafe and unclear support surface for the bone-and-joint risk lesson.

result: Nine selected source assets passed local visual, alpha, semantic and equipment-safety QA. The rejected candidate and its adjusted replacement prompt remain preserved in image-request-log.json.
